description_en: Creates a namespace in a fully managed Flink instance
description_zh: 在flink全托管实例中下创建项目空间
name: CreateNamespace

fields.help_en: The region ID of the workspace
fields.name: region

fields.help_en:
The number of CPUs.
For a subscription workspace, the number of CPUs is required. For a pay-as-you-go workspace, you do not need to specify the number of CPUs.- The number of CPUs for the namespace to be created must be less than the remaining CPUs in the workspace (total purchased CPUs minus CPUs already allocated to other namespaces). Otherwise, an error is returned
fields.help_zh:
CPU数量。
在包年包月的工作空间下，CPU数量必填。在按量付费的工作空间下，可以不用填写CPU数量。- 创建的目标项目空间的CPU数量要小于工作空间中剩余CPU数量（工作空间购买的总CPU数量减去其他项目空间已分配CPU数量），否则会报错
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en:
The memory size. (Unit: GB)
For a subscription workspace, the memory size is required and must be 4 times the number of CPUs. For a pay-as-you-go workspace, you do not need to specify the memory size.- The memory size for the namespace to be created must be less than the remaining memory in the workspace (total purchased memory minus memory already allocated to other namespaces). Otherwise, an error is returned
fields.help_zh:
内存大小。（单位GB）
在包年包月的工作空间下，内存大小必填，且要为CPU数量的4倍。在按量付费的工作空间下，可以不用填写内存大小。- 创建的目标项目空间的内存大小要小于工作空间中剩余内存数量（工作空间购买的总内存数量减去其他项目空间已分配内存数量），否则会报错
fields.name: memory_gb

parameters.help_en: The request parameters required to create a namespace
parameters.help_zh: 创建项目空间所需的请求参数
parameters.name: create_namespace_request
